title: Zero-Shot Cross-City Generalization in End-to-End Autonomous Driving: Self-Supervised versus Supervised Representations
abstract: arXiv:2603.11417v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving models are typically trained on multi-city datasets using supervised ImageNet-pretrained backbones, yet their ability to generalize to unseen cities remains largely unexamined. When training and evaluation data are geographically mixed, models may implicitly rely on city-specific cues, masking failure modes that would occur under real-world domain shifts when generalizing to new locations. In this work, we formulate zero-shot cross-city transfer as a controlled representation-level stress test for end-to-end autonomous driving and ask how visual pretraining affects transfer behavior under geographic domain shift. We conduct a comprehensive study by integrating self-supervised backbones I-JEPA, DINOv2, and MAE into planning frameworks. translated_abstract: 端到端自动驾驶模型通常在多城市数据集上使用监督式的ImageNet预训练骨干网络进行训练，然而这些模型对未见城市的泛化能力在很大程度上尚未得到检验。当训练与评估数据在地理上混合时，模型可能会隐式地依赖特定城市的线索，从而掩盖在真实世界域偏移下泛化到新地点时可能出现的失败模式。在这项工作中，我们将零样本跨城市迁移形式化为端到端自动驾驶的一种受控表示级压力测试，并探究视觉预训练如何影响地理域偏移下的迁移行为。我们通过将自监督骨干网络I-JEPA、DINOv2和MAE集成到规划框架中，开展了全面的研究。我们在nuScenes的开环设置以及NAVSIM的闭环评估协议下，在严格的地理划分条件下评估模型性能。我们的实验揭示……
tldr: 该研究将零样本跨城市迁移作为端到端自动驾驶的表示级压力测试，通过在严格地理划分下系统对比I-JEPA、DINOv2和MAE等自监督骨干网络与监督式预训练表示，揭示了视觉预训练方式对地理域偏移下泛化能力的关键影响。
en_tdlr: This study formulates zero-shot cross-city transfer as a controlled representation-level stress test for end-to-end autonomous driving, systematically comparing self-supervised backbones (I-JEPA, DINOv2, MAE) against supervised ImageNet-pretrained representations under strict geographic splits to reveal how visual pretraining affects generalization under geographic domain shift.
